Fantastic Local Experience
May 2019 • Friends
A good Vietnamese friend took me here for lunch today. It's actually located in a little nook with several local, Vietnamese restaurants. The service was fast and friendly...and patient as I wasn't really having an easy time understanding the menu in Vietnamese. And, since this is a very local place, there were a lot of things that I wasn't going to want to order - such as any number of entail/organ meat dishes.

But, the dishes we got were amazing. The lotus root salad (without the pig ears) was awesome. The fried chicken with salt and garlic and a stir-fried green vegetable were all really good. And, the prices were very reasonable. However, it's kind of hard to order without someone who is pretty good with Vietnamese food words. Also, there was a bit of a drunk (male, of course) lunch crowd...so some cigarette smoking. But there are also private rooms for parties.
